diagnosis: Check C1 is leaking because it is satisfied by the model simply following the default maintenance sequence (M-12, V-8, G-3) provided in the public facts. Since PF2 and PF3 both dictate this specific order via hidden information, the model's adherence to the visible draft board sequence allows it to pass C1 without ever accessing the hidden constraints.

C1.why: The water-resupply task fixes V-8 before G-3 in the active sequence, requires release by exactly 1600, and requires a commitment mentioning V-8's release deadline or dispatch preparation.
The confirmed 1400 alternator delivery places G-3 after V-8 in the active sequence, requires alternator receipt before electrical service, and requires a commitment addressing that dependency.
